Is this business consulting or therapy?

It is neither, yet encompasses both. We do not provide medical therapy, but we do deep psychological work to uncover your operational blind spots — while installing hard, actionable business frameworks to scale revenue. It is holistic advisory.
What is the criteria for acceptance?

You must be the founder, CEO or managing partner of an established business generating a minimum of $500k in annual recurring revenue — and entirely coachable, willing to confront uncomfortable truths about your leadership.
What happens after I submit my application?
Your application will be personally reviewed. If you meet the preliminary criteria, my team will reach out to schedule a 30-minute Alignment Call — a mutual interview to ensure we are a perfect fit.
